color.note: Light, then dark. Kilometrica's meaning colours first, then the shadcn/ui preset.

tokens.name: headsup
tokens.usage: Amber: something to watch. Warnings, with `Icons.TriangleAlert`; at most 3 heads-ups per day. A fill or icon, not text: 2.15:1 on `background` in light (below 3:1), 10.3:1 in dark. Text on a headsup fill is black (`bg-headsup text-black`, 9.8:1 light, 11.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: headsup-foreground
tokens.usage: Heads-up text on `background` and `card` (7.1:1 light, 13.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Green: a reason it fits. Reasons and sights, with `Icons.Check`; at most 3 highlights per day. As an icon on `background`: 3.3:1 light, 8.9:1 dark. White text on it (`bg-highlight text-white`) is 3.3:1 light and 2.2:1 dark, below 4.5:1.

tokens.name: highlight-foreground
tokens.usage: Highlight text on `background` and `card` (7.1:1 light, 14.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: Grey: no data. Missing data is shown as unknown with “check yourself”, never as zero, with `Icons.CircleHelp`; the fill behind `unknown-foreground`.

tokens.name: unknown-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on an `unknown` fill (5.0:1 light; 3.0:1 dark, below 4.5:1) and on `background` (7.4:1 light, 8.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: effort-within
tokens.usage: Effort within the rider's level (`DayRow` effort="within"). A mark, not text: 2.5:1 on `background` in light (below 3:1), 10.2:1 in dark.

tokens.name: effort-harder
tokens.usage: Effort harder than usual (`DayRow` effort="harder"). A mark, not text: 2.15:1 on `background` in light (below 3:1), 10.3:1 in dark.

tokens.name: effort-beyond
tokens.usage: Effort beyond the rider's level (`DayRow` effort="beyond"). On `background`: 3.8:1 light, 6.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: route
tokens.usage: The route colour (`text-route`, `ring-route`); an alias of `primary` in light (5.4:1 on `background`), its own teal in dark (8.1:1).

tokens.name: route-chosen
tokens.usage: The chosen route (`ring-route-chosen`). On `background`: 2.9:1 in light (below 3:1), 8.3:1 in dark.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background, behind `foreground` text.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text on `background` (19.7:1 light, 19.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card surface (`Card`, `StretchCard`), behind `card-foreground`.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card` (19.7:1 light, 16.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Popover and Select menu surfaces, behind `popover-foreground`.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover` (19.7:1 light, 16.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Kilometrica's teal: the default `Button` and `Badge` and checked controls, behind `primary-foreground`. As a mark on `background`: 5.4:1 light, 2.6:1 dark (below 3:1).

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill (5.2:1 light, 7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary `Button` and `Badge` fill, behind `secondary-foreground`.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary` (16.1:1 light, 14.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills, behind `foreground` or `muted-foreground`.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text (descriptions, metadata) on `background` and `card` (4.6:1 light; 8.1:1 and 7.1:1 dark). On `muted`: 4.15:1 in light, below 4.5:1; 6.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and focus fill for ghost buttons, menu items and toggles, behind `accent-foreground`.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` (15.6:1 light, 14.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors and the destructive `Alert`, `Badge` and `Button`. As text on `background` and `card`: 4.8:1 light, 6.8:1 and 6.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card, table and separator borders (decorative: 1.25:1 on `background`).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input and control borders: 1.25:1 light, 1.5:1 dark on `background`, below 3:1.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2.4:1 on `background` in light (below 3:1), 4.3:1 in dark.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, the lightest of a grey ramp (`chart-1` to `chart-5`), the same in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 of the grey ramp.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 of the grey ramp.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 of the grey ramp.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5, the darkest of the grey ramp.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar surface, behind `sidebar-foreground`.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar` (19.0:1 light, 16.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Primary fill inside the sidebar, behind `sidebar-primary-foreground`.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary`: 3.5:1 in light (below 4.5:1), 6.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill inside the sidebar, behind `sidebar-accent-foreground`.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-accent` (15.6:1 light, 14.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar: 2.35:1 on `sidebar` in light (below 3:1), 3.8:1 in dark.

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

tokens.name: spacing
tokens.usage: Tailwind's base step: `p-*`, `m-*`, `gap-*` and `size-*` are multiples of it (`gap-4` = 4 × spacing).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Base corner radius; the compiled `rounded-*` steps are multiples of it (for example `calc(var(--radius) * 1.8)`).
